description: Foldseek TM-score distributions per database against the 0.5 same-fold threshold, and the top 10 structural matches with coverage
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

tm = pd.read_csv("out/foldseek_tmalign_all.csv")
tm = tm[tm.target.str.contains("Q04329")==False]  # drop self-hit
order=["pdb100","cath50","afdb-swissprot","afdb50"]
lab={"pdb100":"PDB100\n(experimental structures)","cath50":"CATH50\n(classified folds)",
     "afdb-swissprot":"AFDB/Swiss-Prot","afdb50":"AFDB/UniProt50"}

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,5.2), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.15,1]})
ax=axes[0]
pos=[]
for i,db in enumerate(order):
    v=tm[tm.db==db].TM.dropna().values
    pos.append(v)
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(v), i)+np.random.RandomState(i).uniform(-0.14,0.14,len(v)), v,
               s=22, alpha=0.65, color="#2980b9", edgecolor="none")
    if len(v): ax.scatter([i],[v.max()], s=70, color="#c0392b", zorder=5)
ax.axhline(0.5, color="#c0392b", ls="--", lw=1.6)
ax.text(3.45,0.512,"TM = 0.5: same-fold threshold\n(Xu & Zhang 2010, PMID 20164152)",
        ha="right", fontsize=8.5, color="#c0392b")
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels([lab[d] for d in order], fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Foldseek TM-align TM-score vs AF-Q04329")
ax.set_ylim(0.25,0.72)
ax.set_title("No structural homolog of ICY1 reaches the fold-assignment threshold\n"
             "best PDB100 hit TM = 0.419 over 45% of the query; best overall TM = 0.454", fontsize=10)
for i,db in enumerate(order):
    v=tm[tm.db==db].TM.dropna().values
    if len(v): ax.text(i, v.max()+0.012, f"max {v.max():.3f}\nn={len(v)}", ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#c0392b")

ax=axes[1]
best = tm.sort_values("TM",ascending=False).head(10).copy()
best["qCov"]=(best.qEnd-best.qStart+1)/127
y=np.arange(len(best))[::-1]
ax.barh(y, best.TM, color="#2980b9", alpha=0.85, label="TM-score")
ax.barh(y-0.0, best.qCov, height=0.28, color="#e67e22", label="query coverage")
ax.axvline(0.5, color="#c0392b", ls="--", lw=1.4)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{t[:46]}\n[{d}]  seqID {s:.1f}%" for t,d,s in
                                      zip(best.target,best.db,best.seqId)], fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("score"); ax.set_xlim(0,1.05); ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("Top 10 hits: all coiled-coil or elongated-helix proteins,\n0.5-8% sequence identity", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("Best hit per database (self-hit removed):")
print(tm.sort_values("TM",ascending=False).groupby("db").head(1)[["db","target","tax","TM","prob","seqId","alnLen","dbLen","qStart","qEnd"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nControl: Foldseek search with only the ordered helix (res 77-127):")
h=json.load(open("out/foldseek_helix77_127.json"))
for d in h["results"]:
    al=d.get("alignments") or []
    flat=al[0] if (al and isinstance(al[0],list)) else al
    print(f"  {d['db']}: {len(flat)} hits")
